description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait' within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides private properties for 'fromDate' and 'toDate' of type DateTime, along with their respective getter and setter methods, facilitating date range filtering functionality in leave-related data transfer objects.

classes.name: DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that encapsulates date range filtering parameters with private DateTime properties and their getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the range, nullable DateTime.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the range with a nullable DateTime parameter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the range, nullable DateTime.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the range with a nullable DateTime parameter.
